summary:
**Climate By Abdullah** is an interactive educational website focused on climate change, global warming, pollution, greenhouse gases, and environmental protection.

**Main Features:**
- Climate Pollution Dashboard with pollution statistics and emissions data.
- Climate Vital Signs showing CO₂, methane, and temperature indicators.
- Interactive climate charts and data comparisons.
- NASA Earth Science information about oceans, atmosphere, ice, and ecosystems.
- Climate Learning Center covering forests, glaciers, oceans, and extreme heat.
- Evidence, Causes & Effects of climate change.
- Earth Information Jukebox with educational data sonification and audio visualization.
- Climate Action Command Center with climate scenario simulations.
- Personal Environmental Impact Calculator.
- Climate Mission Center with quizzes, checklists, and progress tracking.
- Climate AI Assistant for climate-related questions.
- Dark mode, searchable topics, timeline, and Space Explorer.

**Technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, Chart.js, Font Awesome, Web Audio API, and Local Storage.

**Mission:** To make climate science easier to understand through interactive technology and education.

**Tagline:** Learn • Understand • Protect Our Planet
details:
Climate By Abdullah

Climate By Abdullah is an interactive educational website that helps users explore climate change, global warming, greenhouse gases, pollution, and environmental solutions.

Main Features:

  • Pollution Dashboard: Displays pollution information, road transport CO₂ emissions, carbon-emitting company rankings, and company search.
  • Climate Vital Signs: Presents CO₂, methane, and global temperature indicators.
  • Climate Dashboard: Uses interactive charts to explore climate trends and compare environmental data.
  • NASA Earth Science: Explains how satellites monitor Earth's atmosphere, oceans, ice, land, and ecosystems.
  • Learning Center: Covers carbon dioxide, methane, oceans, glaciers, extreme heat, and forests, with a topic search feature.
  • Evidence, Causes & Effects: Explains climate observations, human causes, and environmental impacts.
  • Earth Information Jukebox: Features Earth-data sonification, adjustable climate data controls, audio visualization, and an Earth Signal Monitor.
  • Climate Action Center: Provides interactive scenarios involving temperature, forest protection, and clean energy.
  • Impact Calculator: Offers educational estimates of environmental impact.
  • Mission Center: Includes climate action tasks, quizzes, and progress tracking.
  • Climate AI Assistant: Answers educational questions about climate science, mitigation, and adaptation.
  • Extra Features: Dark mode, climate timeline, Q&A page, Space Explorer, and responsive design.

Technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap 5, Chart.js, Font Awesome, Web Audio API, and Local Storage.

Mission: Make
